structure.unit: Other Regulated Providers of Financial Services

text.section: Within 30 days of judgment against the licensee in a civil action relating to the DMP of a consumer, a licensee shall file a written report with the Commission describing such event and its expected impact upon the business of the licensee. The licensee shall advise the Commission within 30 days of any settlement or the result of any judgment entered.
Within 10 days of receipt of any qualified audit, a licensee shall notify the Commission and describe what steps are being taken to address concerns raised in the audit.
Failure to file a report or other information or documents required under this section shall subject the licensee to a fine of $25 for each day the report is overdue.
